name: Crossfade Custom Expression
description: Transition from the first to the second input, where every pixel and channel is an expression of X, Y, W, H, P, A and B. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: progress
params.description: 0 = first clip, 1 = second clip; at exactly 0 and 1 the output is forced to the first / second clip

params.name: expr
params.description: Result for one color channel, 0..255. X, Y pixel position, W, H size, P = 1 - progress (FFmpeg's P: 1 at the start, 0 at the end), A and B the channel value of the first / second clip, 0..255
